innovations.pressure_point: Generated status artifacts became noisy and occasionally misleading when they embedded live pytest execution output during concurrent validation runs.
innovations.underlying_need: Operators needed test visibility inside governed status artifacts without introducing non-deterministic, self-referential report drift.
alternatives_considered: Keep live pytest execution output in the status snapshot and tolerate report churn between runs.
Remove test reporting from governed artifacts and push operators to separate CLI commands.
Capture a deterministic test inventory with `pytest --collect-only -q` and derive both markdown artifacts from the structured snapshot.
innovations.chosen_approach: Replace live test execution summaries with deterministic collection-only inventory capture inside the canonical status snapshot so the derived markdown remains stable and reproducible.
innovations.outcome: The workspace preserves operator-visible test inventory while avoiding volatile runtime output in governed artifacts, keeping status and summary validation deterministic.

innovations.pressure_point: The governed status model reserved space for resolver capability reporting, but leaving multi-hop modes as placeholders conflicted with the requirement to preserve capability-bearing surfaces without trimming them away.
innovations.underlying_need: The workspace needed real multi-hop resolver behavior that could satisfy status reporting and public API expectations while remaining deterministic, bounded, and JSON-governed.
alternatives_considered: Delete or hide the multi-hop resolver sections from generated status artifacts until implementation capacity improved.
Mark multi-hop support as planned indefinitely and keep reporting placeholder capability flags with no runtime backing.
Implement bounded explicit-path and inferred-route traversal over a small governed tile graph and expose the result through the existing status surfaces.
innovations.chosen_approach: Add deterministic explicit and inferred multi-hop traversal to the resolver registry, then drive the status snapshot from runtime-backed traversal examples instead of placeholder metadata.
innovations.outcome: The workspace preserves the full resolver capability surface, reports true multi-hop support in governed artifacts, and closes the remaining planned-feature gap without violating deterministic or JSON-first constraints.
